# SOP-P3-L2-04 Shift handover - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, EQ-P3-L2-HT03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-019, MM-P3-L2-RR02-S3, MM-P3-L2-SB01

Purpose
1. Define the standardized shift handover for the Ring Rolling line to ensure continuous, safe, and quality production. This procedure applies to operators, leads, and maintenance personnel responsible for EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, and EQ-P3-L2-HT03.

Background and rationale
2. Shift handovers are a critical control point to transfer operational status, outstanding actions, and risk items. Clear and consistent handovers reduce restart time, avoid duplicate work, and preserve quality history. Examples of typical issues transferred: machine alarms, pending maintenance requests, material shortages, or off-spec parts in process.

Key equipment limits and constraints (informational)
3. The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 1415 mm.  
4. The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 13 seconds.

Preconditions (must be completed before initiating handover)
5. Outgoing crew must complete all running checks on EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, and EQ-P3-L2-HT03 and ensure machine status is updated in the line log.  
6. All critical alarms must be acknowledged and documented; unresolved alarms must be listed with current impact and required actions.  
7. Any ongoing maintenance work must be reported and cross-referenced to MM-P3-L2-RR02-S3 or MM-P3-L2-SB01 as applicable.  
8. Quality hold parts or suspect parts must be segregated, tagged, and recorded; reference ECN-2026-019 for disposition guidance.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
9. Outgoing and incoming personnel will wear required PPE for the line: safety helmet, safety glasses, high-visibility vest, cut-resistant gloves, and steel-toe footwear. Follow site PPE policy; if additional containment or respiratory PPE is needed for specific material conditions, note this in the handover log and reference the relevant work instruction.

Handover steps (numbered sequence)
10. Outgoing operator prepares the handover summary:
   a. Complete the line status checklist for EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, EQ-P3-L2-HT03.  
   b. Log last part processed and current part at process hold. If part requires special handling due to size, include the related limit: The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 1415 mm.  
   c. Record any excursions, including location, observed effect, and temporary containment actions. Use the quality hold tag and reference ECN-2026-019 for any engineering change impacts.

11. Incoming operator performs visual and functional verification:
   a. Verify machine power and guarding are in correct states.  
   b. Check that safety interlocks are reset and that there are no active emergency stop conditions.  
   c. Confirm the status of pending maintenance entries referenced to MM-P3-L2-RR02-S3 or MM-P3-L2-SB01.

12. Process-specific verifications:
   a. On EQ-P3-L2-RR02 confirm tooling configuration matches the active job and that bore/OD settings are consistent with the job traveler; be mindful of the 1415 mm outer diameter limit when loading material.  
   b. On EQ-P3-L2-HT03 verify furnace program state and that parts in feed are properly staged; confirm the quench system is ready and note the quench delay threshold: The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 13 seconds. If quench delay approaches or exceeds this threshold, record event and notify maintenance.

13. Material and inventory checks:
   a. Verify next-process material availability and any special handling requirements.  
   b. Record heat numbers, traveler IDs, and the location of segregated suspect parts.

14. Communication of open actions:
   a. List outstanding corrective actions with owner name, brief description, and current status.  
   b. For safety-critical or quality-critical holds, require verbal confirmation and written acknowledgement during sign-off.

Records to keep
15. Maintain the following records in the shift handover folder:
   a. Completed handover checklist and line log.  
   b. Alarm log extracts and photographs of any physical damage or abnormal conditions.  
   c. Tags for quality hold parts and disposition notes referencing ECN-2026-019.  
   d. Maintenance request references to MM-P3-L2-RR02-S3 and MM-P3-L2-SB01.

Examples and common scenarios
16. Example 1 — Material short: If billet supply to EQ-P3-L2-SB01 is insufficient, outgoing crew logs the exact location of remaining stock, last heat number, and scheduled replenishment time. The incoming crew confirms receipt and updates production plan. Cross-reference MM-P3-L2-SB01 for feeder adjustments.  
17. Example 2 — Heat treat quench alert: If EQ-P3-L2-HT03 has registered a quench delay approaching the allowed limit, note the event and immediately flag parts processed during the window for inspection. Use the exact quench delay maximum statement in communications.

Escalation and maintenance coordination
18. If an unresolved machine condition could affect safety or product integrity, escalate to line lead and maintenance. Reference MM-P3-L2-RR02-S3 for service-level details and ensure a maintenance work order is documented.

Sign-off
19. Outgoing operator signs and timestamps the handover checklist and provides a verbal briefing to incoming operator. Both parties must initial the line log entry. If supervisory acknowledgement is required, the line lead or supervisor signs after reviewing documented items.

Audit and compliance
20. Handover records will be retained per plant records retention policy. Periodic audits will reference ECN-2026-019, MM-P3-L2-RR02-S3, and MM-P3-L2-SB01 to verify compliance and traceability.

Revision control
21. This document is controlled under the plant document control system. Refer to ECN-2026-019 for approved changes affecting process limits or controls.
